🔒 5. L5 Momentum Bifurcation (n=5,420) Naive: 48.2% (-7.9%) → Redirect: 58.1% (+10.9% ROI)

Books shade 4/5 & 5/5 Over streaks by +1.6 to +2.4 pts. Active Rule: Auto-fade L5 streaks (PLAY UNDER: 56.8% Win / +8.4% ROI) when MPG/USG% are flat (<+1.5) and TS% is +8%+ above baseline. Only bet Over when backed by ≥+3.5 MPG & ≥+3.0% USG% role expansion (59.4% Win / +13.4% ROI).

🔒 6. H2H Continuity & 48-Hr Duplex Gate (n=4,680) Naive: 50.4% (-3.8%) → Redirect: 59.6% (+13.8% ROI)

38% annual roster churn & 2.1-yr coach half-life kill raw 3–5 yr H2H value (r=0.04). Active Rule: Zero out (0% weight) H2H >18 mos or vs. changed coach/anchor. Apply max 12% weight (+1.8% True Win) ONLY when same coach + defensive shell remain active—peaking in 48-Hr Same-Building Baseball Series (+2.6% / 61.2% Win).

🔒 7. 1–2 Day Rest Sweet Spot vs. 3+ Day Rust (n=3,890) Naive: 49.1% (-6.2%) → Redirect: 57.4% (+9.6% ROI)

3+ days off causes a -1.9% 1H 3P% rhythm rust dip while books price a +1.0 pt rest premium. Active Rule: Peak Over boost (+1.4%) goes to 1–2 Days Rest Home vs. Road B2B. On 3+ Days Rest, veto 3PM/1H Jump-Shooter Overs (56.4% Under Win) and only boost high-FTA rim slashers (≥6.5 FTA/g, 57.9% Win).

🔒 8. Referee Whistle Asymmetry & Foul Cascade (n=4,430) Naive: 51.1% (-2.4%) → Redirect: 58.9% (+12.4% ROI)

Top-5 high-whistle crews (+5.4 FTA/g) spike 1Q/1H starter foul-trouble benchings by +34%! Active Rule: Boost ONLY low-foul FT initiators (<2.4 PF/36m, ≥7.0 FTA/g → +2.4% Over / 59.1% Win) and pivot high-foul bigs/wings (≥3.4 PF/36m vs. top FT drawers) to Points/1H UNDERS (+4.2% Under / 58.6% Win).
